veadotube.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to veadotube.

veadotube.changeState.description: Changes your veadotube avatar state, optionally only for some seconds.

parameters.state: The state's name. For Random, several names separated by commas, or leave it out for any.
parameters.mode: Optional. Set, Push, Pop, Toggle, Random or Clear. The default is Set.
parameters.seconds: Optional. Seconds until it goes back.
parameters.node: Optional. A State Events node's name in full veadotube; leave it out for veadotube mini.
parameters.instance: Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one.

veadotube.changeState.returns: The id of the state that was sent.

veadotube.getState.description: Reads which avatar state is showing.

parameters.node: Optional. A State Events node's name in full veadotube.
parameters.instance: Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one.

veadotube.getState.returns: An object with state, stateId, states (all names) and image (the state's picture as a data: address).

veadotube.setPushToTalk.description: Turns push-to-talk (or another on/off node) on, off or the other way, optionally only for some seconds.

parameters.state: Optional. On, Off or Toggle. The default is On.
parameters.seconds: Optional. Seconds until it is set back.
parameters.node: Optional. A Boolean node's name in full veadotube.
parameters.instance: Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one.

veadotube.setPushToTalk.returns: The value asked for (true or false), when known.

veadotube.setNumber.description: Sets or adds to a Number node in full veadotube.

parameters.add: Optional. true to add to the current value.
parameters.min: Optional. The lowest value of the node's range (give max too).
parameters.max: Optional. The highest value of the node's range.
parameters.instance: Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one.

veadotube.setNumber.returns: The node's value afterwards, when known.

veadotube.getNumber.description: Reads a Number node's value in full veadotube.

parameters.instance: Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one.

veadotube.getNumber.returns: An object with value, min and max, or null when it has no value.
